description: Docker support, documentation, and final polish. Depends on all previous FEATs. Adds Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, README.md, and all docs/ markdown files. Also ensures the full end-to-end flow works and adds any missing __init__.py files or exports identified during prior FEATs.
steps: Create Dockerfile: FROM python:3.11-slim. WORKDIR /app. COPY requirements.txt . RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt. COPY . . RUN pip install -e . --no-deps. Create directories: RUN mkdir -p /app/database /app/logs /app/models/anomaly /app/models/classifier. EXPOSE 8000. ENV CS_DB_PATH=/app/database/cyber_sentinel.db CS_MODELS_DIR=/app/models CS_LOG_LEVEL=INFO. Default CMD: ['python','-m','uvicorn','cyber_sentinel.api.main:app','--host','0.0.0.0','--port','8000'].

Create docker-compose.yml with two services: api (build: ., ports: 8000:8000, volumes: ./database:/app/database, ./models:/app/models, ./data:/app/data, ./logs:/app/logs, env_file: .env) and dashboard (build: ., command: streamlit run src/cyber_sentinel/dashboard/app.py --server.port 8501 --server.headless true, ports: 8501:8501, volumes same as api, depends_on: api). Add a network: sentinel-net.

Create README.md with these sections: title+badge row (Python 3.11+, License MIT, Hackathon), Overview paragraph (what the system does, two sentences), Architecture diagram (ASCII from the spec), Quick Start (5 steps: clone, pip install -e .[dev], generate data, train, run analyze + dashboard + api), CLI Reference (table of all commands + options), API Reference (table of all endpoints), Configuration (explain config.yaml and policy.yaml), Docker Usage (docker-compose up), Sample Output (show example CLI table output, example JSON analysis response), Project Structure (tree), Technical Notes (synthetic data disclaimer, feature engineering explanation), License.

Create docs/architecture.md: detailed explanation of the pipeline — each component (ingestion, feature engineering, anomaly detection, classifier, risk engine, outputs), data flow diagram, design decisions (why Isolation Forest, why Random Forest, sliding window rationale, risk formula derivation).

Create docs/detection.md: explain the dual-layer detection approach, describe each of the 26 features and what threat behavior they capture, explain the five threat classes and their behavioral signatures, explain the evidence generation logic.
Create docs/api.md: full API reference with curl examples for every endpoint, request/response schemas, error codes, authentication note (none in v1 — add a TODO for API key auth).

Create docs/demo.md: step-by-step demo walkthrough — install, generate data, train, run each attack type through the CLI, observe risk scores and evidence, run the dashboard, call the API, show expected outputs for each attack type.

Audit all src/cyber_sentinel/*/__init__.py files: ensure every subpackage exports its main public classes/functions. Verify no circular imports by checking that: ingestion does NOT import from detection or risk; features does NOT import from detection or risk; detection imports from features only; risk imports from detection only via return values (not direct import of pipeline); api and cli import from all layers but are not imported by any layer; dashboard imports from database and config only.

Final integration check: ensure the complete flow works end-to-end: python scripts/generate_demo_data.py → python scripts/train_models.py → python scripts/ingest.py data/samples/mixed.jsonl → python -m cyber_sentinel.cli.main alerts → python -m cyber_sentinel.cli.main analyze data/samples/port_scan.jsonl --max-risk 40 should exit 1. Fix any import errors, path resolution bugs, or missing dependencies discovered during this check.
acceptance_criteria: docker build -t cyber-sentinel . completes without error (or if Docker not available, Dockerfile is syntactically correct)
README.md exists and has all sections: Overview, Quick Start, CLI Reference, API Reference, Docker Usage
docs/architecture.md, docs/detection.md, docs/api.md, docs/demo.md all exist with meaningful content
